inclusions.source: Duration · 2 days / 1 night, return domestic flights included

inclusions.text: Accommodation at the Karnak Luxor Hotel
inclusions.source: Accommodation is at the Karnak Luxor Hotel, a functional, well-located property close to the East Bank sites — rested and close to the monuments, which is the brief.

inclusions.text: Fully private · own licensed Egyptologist · air-conditioned vehicle in Luxor · hotel night at the Karnak Luxor Hotel
inclusions.source: Character · Fully private · own licensed Egyptologist · air-conditioned vehicle in Luxor · early morning flight south · hotel night at the Karnak Luxor Hotel close to the East Bank
You depart Cairo early — expect a morning pickup from your hotel ahead of a domestic flight south.

inclusions.text: Guide and vehicle meet you on arrival
inclusions.source: A guide and vehicle meet you on arrival and move directly to the first site.

inclusions.text: Guide transfers you to the Karnak Luxor Hotel
inclusions.source: After the temples, the guide transfers you to the Karnak Luxor Hotel to check in.

exclusions.text: Some tombs (notably KV62) carry separate tickets
exclusions.source: The second-day West Bank programme varies by operator — the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut's temple, and the Colossi of Memnon are the most common combination, with some tombs (notably KV62) carrying separate tickets.

itinerary.title: Fly to Luxor: Karnak and Luxor Temple
itinerary.source: After the temples, the guide transfers you to the Karnak Luxor Hotel to check in.

itinerary.title: West Bank and flight back to Cairo
itinerary.source: Return to the airport for your flight back to Cairo follows in the afternoon or early evening, depending on scheduling.
